patch_description: Prior gains (0.57→0.71) came from restart sweeps over diverse good basins. We (a) diversify the seed portfolio with three structurally distinct basins — a 9+4 two-cluster arc config with a different cluster ratio, a reversed-chirality logarithmic spiral, and a perturbed convex 13-gon — and (b) rebalance the time budget: phase 1 (full sweep over all seeds) uses ~55% of total time with hard per-seed truncation so every basin is explored; the remaining time alternates short strict re-anneal polish-kicks on the top-2 seeds found in phase 1, which explores deep local optima around the two most promising basins instead of over-polishing a single incumbent.
